newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's, Disney set promotion plans.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's, Disney set promotion plans.

text.p: McDonald's Corp. and Walt Disney Co. said Wednesday they kicked off their previously announced exclusive 10-year marketing alliance with three consecutive promotions.

In May, McDonald's will feature a "Celebrate Disney Music" promotion, offering three different collections of music from Disney films. A portion of the proceeds from each sale will be donated to Ronald McDonald House Charities.
McDonald's also will offer collectible toy Disney characters in its Happy Meals for children during May.

McDonald's, the largest fast-food operator, with more than 12,000 U.S. stores, also will launch a promotion with Disney's Hercules animated movie, which is scheduled to open in June. The promotion includes Hercules toy characters in McDonald's Happy Meals and special food offers.
In July, McDonald's will tie in with Disney's expected July release of "George of the Jungle", a live-action film based on the television cartoon of the 1960s.
The plans follow McDonald's promotion last year with Disney's 101 Dalmatians movie, which was not part of the 10-year marketing alliance.

"Last year's 101 Dalmatians holiday movie promotion produced the most successful Happy Meal in our history, which speaks to the tremendous customer appeal of the McDonald's-Disney partnership," Brad Ball, senior vice president, USA marketing, said in a statement.
